name: sg_stats_get
description: Retrieve email statistics aggregated from the mail send log, blocks, and bounces between two dates, aggregated by day, week, or month. (GET /v3/stats)

start_date.description: The starting date of the statistics to retrieve. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

end_date.description: The end date of the statistics to retrieve. Defaults to today. Must follow format YYYY-MM-DD.

aggregated_by.description: How to group the statistics. Must be either day, week, or month. Defaults to day.
